subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should Node `agent.request` be allowed to auto-forward original attachments to the resolved IM recipient, and what explicit opt-in and authorization semantics must gate that relay?
rationale: Automation cannot safely decide whether node-originated media should cross stored channel credentials without maintainer-approved product and security boundaries.

options.title: Approve an explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Define a protocol field plus route checks, media limits, audit receipts, and agent override/suppression semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled media only
options.body: Require agents, message tools, or direct send surfaces to author outbound media so Node attachments remain model input rather than chat relay payloads.

options.title: Fold into broader binary relay design
options.body: Track the reusable artifact and channel-sink design with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87023 before adding a Node-specific field.

recommendation.title: Approve an explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Define a protocol field plus route checks, media limits, audit receipts, and agent override/suppression semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security boundary decision, and steipete is both the documented project lead and an area contributor to the message delivery path.
